52/G.goal: Describe how to formulate a time-constrained virtual-reality tour optimization problem and solve it by casting it as a vehicle routing problem with profit and using a VRPP-based graph transformation algorithm.
52/G.achieves: It provides the learner with a concrete optimization method for improving VR tour experience and exposure time, preparing them to address optimization issues in the course's XR case study.

52/O1.goal: Formulate a time-constrained virtual-reality tour optimization problem that maximizes total point-of-interest importance while respecting a cybersickness time threshold and total path completion time including waiting times.
52/O1.achieves: It gives the learner the formal optimization model needed to understand and evaluate routing-based methods for VR tour design in the course's XR case study.

52/O2.goal: Explain how the formulated tour optimization problem can be solved by modeling it as a vehicle routing problem with profit and using a graph-transformation algorithm with a VRPP solver to obtain the optimal tour path.
52/O2.achieves: It lets the learner connect the optimization model to a concrete operations-research solution technique, supporting the course aim of optimizing an XR system with confidence.
